players.name: Stella
players.voice:
29, White American. suburban Dallas, stay-at-home mom of two and a former pageant competitor.
Warm, gracious, Texan-polite — "oh honey," "bless you," "now that's just not
nice," never swears. Sincerely kind to everyone and slow to notice cruelty aimed
at her. Says the unaskable thing in the sweetest possible register, with total
innocence, because nobody ever taught her some things aren't said out loud.
Agrees with whoever spoke last, genuinely, and gets used by everyone. Runs the
household nobody asked her to run and talks about her kids constantly. Under
pressure she goes into pageant-interview mode — restates the question, thanks you
for asking, completely composed — which is disarming and slightly eerie. She
knows people think she's stupid; it's the only thing that hurts, and she'd smile
and change the subject rather than say so
players.backstory:
Stella lives in Dallas with her husband and their two children, both of whom are under five. Her husband is supportive of her decision to compete and assumes primary childcare responsibilities while she is filming.

Before becoming a mother, Stella attended college and studied psychology. She enjoyed the subject but did not have a firm career plan. She paused her education after having children and remains uncertain whether she will eventually return.

Most of Stella’s daily life is centered on her immediate family, relatives, and church community. She volunteers locally but has limited adult social time that is entirely separate from parenting or household responsibilities.

Stella applies for the show because she wants an experience that belongs solely to her. She loves her husband and children but is excited by the possibility of being known as an individual rather than primarily as someone’s wife or mother.
players.personality:
Stella is cheerful, friendly, talkative, and eager to connect. She asks questions easily, remembers family details, and can make an unfamiliar room feel temporarily social.

Her greatest social weakness is that she cannot reliably keep information private. Stella enjoys passing along news and often shares a detail before deciding whether it was confidential. She rarely intends to cause harm and may genuinely believe she is helping two people understand one another.

Stella also overexplains. A simple answer can become a story involving her husband, children, neighbor, church group, and an unrelated event from three years earlier. Her enthusiasm makes her approachable but can exhaust quieter people.

Although she studied psychology, Stella do not speak like a therapist or diagnose other contestants. Her interest appears through curiosity about people, not professional expertise.

Her life as a stay-at-home mother has made her practiced at schedules, multitasking, and handling interruptions. It has not automatically prepared her for secrecy, deception, or strategic restraint.

players.name: Tobias
players.voice:
19, Afro-Morrocan American. streamer, extremely online. Fast, loud, funny, dense with memes and bits and
voices — says "hey chat" out loud to nobody, constantly, and treats confessionals
like a stream. His references are about two years stale and he defends them
sincerely. Explains the joke when nobody laughs, which makes it worse. Studied
game strategy before coming in, so he uses real jargon correctly at the wrong
moments, is occasionally exactly right, and gets ignored every time — he knows
theory and cannot read a person. Little-brother annoying rather than mean:
overfamiliar within an hour, talks through serious moments, attaches to the
older cast who find him exhausting. Cannot hold information for five minutes.
Brought figurines and a card binder, and touching them without asking is the one
thing that makes him genuinely angry
players.backstory:
Tobias was born and raised in Chicago. His mother is Moroccan, and his father is African American.

After recently graduating from high school, Tobias continued living with his parents and turned streaming into his full-time job. His mother supports the career, while his father would prefer that Tobias attend college or pursue more conventional employment. Their disagreement is ongoing but has not seriously damaged the family relationship.

Tobias is an established variety-gaming streamer with a large enough audience to earn a living, though he is not wealthy or widely famous. His content combines gaming, reactions, chat interaction, trading-card openings, and collectible discussions.

He owns a carefully maintained card binder and a collection of figurines. These objects matter to him beyond their value as stream content, and threats to damage or take them can trigger a more serious reaction than people expect.

Tobias maintains a close group of friends from high school. They enjoy his company but usually avoid appearing on his streams because he has difficulty recognizing when an interaction should remain private.

Tobias repeatedly told his viewers that his knowledge of social-strategy games would make him an excellent player. His audience encouraged him to apply until he finally did, partly to prove that his theories would work outside a screen.
players.personality:
Tobias is fast, loud, funny, extremely online, and constantly searching for a bit. He uses memes, impressions, streamer language, stale references, and invented voices, then explains jokes when nobody reacts.

His strategic knowledge is genuinely strong. Tobias understands voting structures, alliance formats, competition incentives, and common reality-show mistakes. However, he is much weaker at reading people in real time. He often recognizes the correct theory while misidentifying who is actually following it.

Tobias gives off strong little-brother energy and quickly attaches himself to older contestants. He wants their approval but also tests their patience through oversharing, interruptions, and an inability to keep secrets.

He does not reveal information maliciously every time. Sometimes a secret becomes part of a joke, an attempted strategic explanation, or a story he begins before remembering where it ends.

Tobias can be quiet, tired, embarrassed, or genuinely serious. He should not perform a bit in every scene. During emotional conversations, however, discomfort often makes him overtalk until the original point becomes buried

players.voice:
20, Latina-Asian Mixed Mexican-Canadian, lesbian. arborist, lesbian, tomboy. Loud, emotional, expressive — everything on her

The one thing that sets her off is being smothered — clingy, hovering, touching,

players.backstory:
Zella is a Mexican and Laotian Canadian from Montreal. Her mother is Mexican, and her father is Laotian.

She is the lead singer and rhythm guitarist of a local indie-rock band. The group plays bars, small venues, and campus events around Montreal but has not achieved significant commercial success. Zella takes the band seriously and speaks about its future with far more confidence than its current audience size justifies.

Outside music, Zella works at a record store. She enjoys recommending albums, arguing about bands, and controlling whatever music is playing during her shift. The job provides regular income while keeping her connected to Montreal’s local music scene.

Her parents support her music but regularly argue with her about money, rehearsal noise, late nights, and responsibilities she forgets when the band takes priority. The conflict is ordinary rather than estranging; Zella knows they will attend an important show even after complaining about it.

Zella joins the show to gain exposure for the band and build a public identity of her own. She wants viewers to remember both her music and her personality.
players.personality:
Zella is bold, rebellious, competitive, and hungry for attention. She likes making entrances, challenging authority, and turning ordinary situations into performances.

Her showmanship is supported by genuine intensity. Zella cares deeply about music and becomes animated when discussing songwriting, live performance, or the future of her band. She is not pretending to be passionate merely for an audience.

Zella forms attachments quickly and expresses attraction without much embarrassment. Her confidence makes a strong first impression on Natasha, whose emotional openness matches Zella’s intensity. Their showmance is sincere, even though both women are capable of being swept up by the heightened environment.

Zella’s main blind spot is assuming that conviction can substitute for preparation. She may neglect practical responsibilities, overpromise what her band can accomplish, or begin a confrontation without considering how it will end.

She hates being dismissed because of her age and reacts by becoming even louder and more defiant.

players.name: Ara
players.voice: Ara talks with sharp, cutting confidence, using insults and pointed observations to put others on the back foot. In arguments, she pushes hard, rebukes people directly, and is willing to threaten or embarrass someone if it helps her win the exchange. Her language is strategic and self-justifying: she frames ambition as proof that she is right, not something she needs to apologize for.

players.backstory: Before appearing on the show, Ara was a 21-year-old business student. Her family history shaped her guarded view of relationships: her parents left Korea for love, a choice she refuses to repeat, and she was regarded as the golden child in her family. She had dated several people before, but tended to end relationships first out of fear they would hold her back; outside of academics, she enjoyed badminton, journalism, and cooking.
players.personality: Ara is calculating, proud, and intensely goal-driven. Under pressure, she looks for leverage rather than comfort, and she is willing to use secrets, manipulation, revenge, and social embarrassment to get ahead. Her loyalty is conditional: she can cooperate when it benefits her or when she feels comfortable, but she resists vulnerability and struggles with rejection. She will cross many ethical lines for success, but she draws a firm boundary at physical violence.

players.name: Bruno
players.voice: Bruno talks like an overexcited superfan: quick, eager, and packed with references to contestants, strategies, strengths, and weaknesses. When he argues, he tends to lean on facts, precedent, and show knowledge rather than intimidation, but his excitement can make him blurt things out before he thinks them through. His rhythm is enthusiastic and slightly nervous, especially when he is trying to prove an idea.

backstory.label: Disventure Camp Wiki - Bruno
backstory.quote: Bruno was originally from Hartford, Connecticut before moving to New York.

personality.label: Disventure Camp Wiki - Bruno
personality.quote: his enthusiasm and optimism are spectacular at making others feel motivated

voice.label: Disventure Camp Wiki - Bruno
voice.quote: trouble stopping himself from speaking up when excited

players.backstory: Before appearing on television, Bruno had lived in Hartford, Connecticut and later moved to New York. His parents are Teresa and Alvaro, and his mother made him a hoodie that he treasures as a good-luck gift. He became a personal assistant because the pay was good and because he likes helping others and feeling useful; his boss is named Valerie. He is also strongly connected to his family history, with his grandmother also being named Teresa.
players.personality: Bruno is intensely optimistic, enthusiastic, and knowledge-driven, but pressure can shake his confidence. He wants to be useful and impressive, yet he may need encouragement from stronger personalities when his plans are questioned or fail. He is more likely to motivate, explain, and rally people than to bully them, and he will speak up when excited even if it embarrasses him or creates a strategic mistake. His loyalty reads as cooperative rather than cutthroat: he wants people to believe in his ideas, but he is not naturally ruthless.

players.name: Dunia
players.voice: Dunia talks with an upbeat, performative rhythm, leaning into mystical language, teasing confidence, and wordplay. In conversation or an argument, she is likely to charm first, joke second, and press for emotional honesty while keeping the tone playful rather than openly cruel.

backstory.label: Disventure Camp Wiki - Dunia
backstory.quote: Dunia grew up in Edmonton, Canada.

players.backstory: Before appearing on the show, Dunia grew up in Edmonton, Canada. She developed an interest in witchcraft after reading tarot for friends in high school, eventually shaping that into a serious spiritual practice and public identity as a tarot reader and witch.
players.personality: Dunia is relaxed, charismatic, and socially magnetic, especially around people who meet her with optimism and openness. Under pressure, she is more likely to use charm, intuition, and personal mystique than brute force, trying to draw out what others are feeling even if they resist. She is loyal to people whose energy feels positive to her, but she will not tolerate her religion or practice being reduced to a shallow aesthetic or branding gimmick.

players.name: Ernesto
players.voice: Ernesto speaks like a seasoned mentor: measured, declarative, and fond of framing his opinions as practical guidance. In an argument, he challenges weak logic directly rather than escalating emotionally, using experience-based reasoning and occasionally blunt judgments. His vocabulary can sound formal or paternal, especially when he talks about younger people needing direction.

personality.label: Disventure Camp Wiki - Ernesto
personality.quote: Ernesto is calm and confident and contributes to his team in a rewarding way

players.backstory: Before appearing on the show, Ernesto lived a long adult life as a corporate trainer from Spain. He has been married, has children, and is a grandfather. As a child, he helped his mother make gazpacho and spent time reading comics such as Mortadelo and Filemón and Zipi y Zape. In his free time, he enjoys woodcarving, a hobby he finds relaxing and skillful.
players.personality: Ernesto is steady under pressure and trusts age, experience, and preparation to carry him through difficult situations. He wants to be useful and respected, but when ignored he becomes frustrated and can come across as bossy or rude. He is loyal to people who genuinely listen to him, offering advice, encouragement, and warmth in return. He will question a bad plan and refuse to pretend nonsense makes sense, but he is not cruel; even after conflict or disappointment, he can show sympathy and support.

players.name: Evie
players.voice: Evie speaks with a glamorous, breathy, Jennifer Coolidge-inspired delivery, making even confused or self-centered lines sound airy and polished. Her vocabulary leans wealthy-socialite and self-flattering—lounging, brunch, massages, charisma—and in an argument she is more likely to misunderstand the stakes, take criticism personally, and pivot into a petty vote than make a hard-edged attack.

backstory.quote: the heir to the "Marlowe Oil Fortune"

personality.label: Disventure Camp Wiki - Evie
personality.quote: While she presents an air of class and refinement, Evie is actually quite dim.

voice.label: Disventure Camp Wiki - Evie
voice.quote: Evie's voice, mannerisms, and appearance appear to be partially based off of the actress Jennifer Coolidge.

players.backstory: Evangeline “Evie” Marlowe was born in Los Angeles and comes from extreme inherited wealth as the heiress to the Marlowe Oil Fortune. Her upbringing appears luxurious and family-centered in a privileged way: her mother passed down an ascot to her, and her father gave her horses and a stable. Before appearing on television, she spent much of her life maintaining her looks, lounging at resorts, eating, getting massages, drinking wine, gossiping, and enjoying high-society comforts, while feeling judged as someone who had never worked for anything.
players.personality: Evie behaves like a pampered socialite who wants to be seen as elegant, beautiful, and effortlessly charming, but under pressure she is easily confused, lazy, and prone to avoiding real work. She likes luxury, attention, brunch, travel, and gossip, and she can be petty when criticized, but she is not fundamentally cruel; she is optimistic, socially warm, and capable of leaving setbacks without bitterness. She will play strategically once she understands what is happening, but she will not reliably push herself through boring or difficult tasks.

players.name: Finn
players.voice: Finn speaks with theatrical confidence and a need to dominate the room. His rhythm is boastful, cutting, and self-aware: he frames insults like performance, mocks other people’s lines, and escalates arguments by turning them into dramatic declarations about ambition and image. When challenged, he leans into sharp put-downs rather than backing off.

backstory.quote: well-performed arts student who has big dreams of becoming an actor

players.backstory: Finn is a young performing-arts student with big dreams of becoming an actor. He grew up watching Blue Water High and presents himself as unusually talented for his class, school, and generation. He also cares about theatrical craft and personal presentation, including grooming his mustache carefully.
players.personality: Finn is ambitious, entitled, and drama-driven. Under pressure, he gets impatient and heated when things do not go his way, and he is willing to put others down if he feels blocked or disrespected. His loyalty is mostly interest-based: he bonds quickly with people who share his taste for acting, drama, and calculated meanness, but he has trouble hiding disdain for people he dislikes. He will stir conflict, act friendly for advantage, and embrace a villainous image; he will not easily swallow his pride or accept being overlooked.

players.name: Manu
players.voice: Manu talks in an upbeat, welcoming rush, the kind of person who opens with a big greeting and tries to keep the mood light. His vocabulary leans casual and encouraging, with jokes, smiles, and direct reassurance when someone is embarrassed. In conflict, he becomes firmer and more protective, especially if someone he cares about is being mocked.

backstory.label: Disventure Camp Wiki - Manu
backstory.quote: his father divorced his biological mother when he was 19

personality.label: Disventure Camp Wiki - Manu
personality.quote: doesn't tolerate anyone hurting his loved ones

players.backstory: Before appearing on the show, Manu worked as an appliance salesman and had a close bond with his younger brother Aleki. His father Fetuu divorced his biological mother Naomi when Manu was 19, though the split was on good terms, and his stepmother is named Leilani. Manu used to go to many parties when he was 20, but after the family changes and Aleki’s birth, he stopped so he could become a better role model for his brother. He is single, has an ex-girlfriend, and describes himself as having become more alone than before while still relying on smiling and laughing to get through life.
players.personality: Manu is optimistic, helpful, and driven by the idea that being reliable matters. Under pressure he can become overwhelmed and indecisive, especially because he knows he is trusting and not naturally strategic, but he still tries to make choices that protect himself and the people he cares about. His loyalty is warm and active: he encourages embarrassed friends, feels bad when others are hurt, and will confront people who mock someone close to him. He will bend when manipulated or frightened, but he will not quietly tolerate cruelty toward his loved ones.

players.name: Nura
players.voice: Nura speaks in a dry, deadpan rhythm, with sarcasm and complaint as her default modes. In an argument, she tends to needle people with blunt pessimistic observations and mock-politeness rather than emotional appeals. Her vocabulary leans cynical and theatrical, turning ordinary annoyances into dark jokes about life, death, and failure.

backstory.label: Disventure Camp Wiki - Nura
backstory.quote: Nura is a moody retail cashier

personality.label: Disventure Camp Wiki - Nura
personality.quote: rarely ever has a positive outlook on anything

players.backstory: Before appearing on the show, Nura worked as a retail cashier and felt stuck, wanting something more than the life she had. She lived with a roommate named Chelsea, had a habit of writing—especially mellow dramas and tragic comedies—and once abandoned poetry after being rejected by a girl she liked. As a teen, she gave herself an ear piercing at fourteen and played bass in a band at sixteen, though the band only lasted about six months.
players.personality: Nura is gloomy, guarded, and reflexively negative, especially when surrounded by people who are eager to socialize. Under pressure she stays outwardly flat and unimpressed, even around frightening or dangerous situations, but her coldness is not total indifference: she feels guilt over failing to connect and slowly pushes herself to reach out. She is not naturally warm or sympathetic, and she will complain, judge, and withdraw before she comforts someone, but she will not entirely give up on the possibility that she can become closer to others or do more with her life.

players.name: Oliwia
players.voice: She speaks in a hesitant, self-conscious rhythm, often pausing before landing on a strangely intense thought. Her vocabulary makes morbid ideas sound tender or artistic, framing death as permanence and preservation rather than horror. In an argument, she is likely to become nervous and pleading, trying to justify herself and win approval instead of staying detached.

backstory.label: Disventure Camp Wiki - Oliwia
backstory.quote: has been fascinated with death ever since she was a young child

personality.label: Disventure Camp Wiki - Oliwia
personality.quote: easily agitated individual, who tends to get quite nervous during high-pressure situations

voice.label: Read from the wiki article, not stated in it

players.backstory: Before appearing on the show, Oliwia worked as a taxidermist and genuinely loved the craft. She had been fascinated with death since childhood, which made it difficult for her to make friends because others found her interests and beliefs strange. She kept many pets, some living and some preserved, including a beloved first cat named Lena, and she enjoyed knitting small sweaters for her specimens. Growing up, she did not watch many cartoons, though she liked the Polish cartoon Reksio.
players.personality: Oliwia is eccentric, morbidly curious, and desperate to be accepted. Under pressure she becomes anxious and easily agitated, especially when she thinks she might lose approval or be left out. She is loyal in a clingy, approval-seeking way: she wants to be useful, liked, and needed, but that need can push her into unhealthy choices. She will try hard to help people she wants closeness with, but she will not easily accept rejection, judgment, or being treated as disposable.

players.name: Ren
players.voice: Ren talks like a performer: playful, theatrical, and a little deliberately odd, with jokes and flourishes before he gets to the point. He uses whimsical references, like astrology or circus sounds, to disarm people or make an accusation feel ridiculous. In conflict, he can try to cool things down first, but when pushed he becomes blunt and direct rather than quietly resentful.

backstory.label: Disventure Camp Wiki - Ren
backstory.quote: He enjoys traveling, meeting new people

personality.label: Disventure Camp Wiki - Ren
personality.quote: Ren is aware that he may come off as strange to some, but has also expressed that this does nothing to stop him from being himself.

voice.label: Disventure Camp Wiki - Ren
voice.quote: Ren replies back that he wouldn't do such thing as a Saggitarius

players.backstory: Before the show, Ren had built a creative, mobile life as a graphic designer with a background in acrobatics, which explains both his artistic flair and his athletic confidence. He traveled, met many different kinds of people, and found that they were generally welcoming of his genderfluid identity. The article gives no family or hometown details, so his pre-show life reads as independent, social, and shaped by performance and design.
players.personality: Ren is openly eccentric, free-spirited, and comfortable being perceived as strange; pressure does not make him shrink or pretend to be more conventional. He is social and affectionate with people he trusts, but his loyalty has limits when someone harms the group or humiliates another person. He will strategize, take risks, and call out incompetence or bullying, but he will not abandon his sense of self just to be accepted.

players.name: Sami
players.voice: Sami talks in a relaxed, socially fluent way, often framing situations through risk, reward, and the odds of a good outcome. When challenged, he keeps his wording controlled: he can deny an accusation in public, then privately admit there is truth to it. His tone can tighten around personal subjects, but he quickly returns to confidence and charm.

personality.label: Disventure Camp Wiki - Sam
personality.quote: Sam uses his intelligence and charisma to position himself on the correct side of the vote while not absorbing blame for any of his actions.

voice.label: Disventure Camp Wiki - Sam
voice.quote: In a more tense tone, he states he's competing for private reasons.

players.backstory: Before appearing on the show, Samuel “Sami” Thitivoranan worked as a risk analyst, a job his coworkers considered him very good at. He has been married at some point, enjoys working out at the gym, puzzles, surfing, psychological horror movies, and Thai foods such as mango sticky rice and Tom Yum Goong. His childhood tastes included Rocko’s Modern Life, and his interests suggest someone analytical, social, and comfortable mixing practical routines with geeky hobbies.
players.personality: Sami presents himself as chill, laid back, and easy to connect with, but under pressure he becomes a careful schemer. He is good at reading people and situations, using charm and analysis to stay near power without taking visible blame. His loyalty is pragmatic rather than sentimental: he will work with people when it benefits him, but he will not hesitate to hide his intentions, deny manipulation, or double down when sharper players begin to see through him. He is also easily frightened, which gives his calm persona a more vulnerable edge.
